case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Reviews describe generally positive experiences with friendly staff and satisfactory rooms—guests praised beds and bathroom finishes and several said “everything” was good—while noting specific negatives: location concerns (distance from Lisbon and an incorrect address that caused delays) alongside one positive mention of location, an expensive breakfast, and room issues such as noisy windows and needs for textile and paint improvements.

review_summary_metadata.summary_method: Neutral LLM summary of the frozen recent review sample; no additional reviews retrieved.

priorities.recommendation: Immediately verify/correct website/booking addresses; publish arrival instructions and printable confirmation directions/contacts; train front-desk staff.
Conduct a targeted room-condition audit, implement short-term fixes, plan upgrades, and inform guests.
Review breakfast price/composition against market expectations; consider tiered or bundled options, evaluate uptake/feedback 4–8 weeks.
Review parking policy/pricing, audit capacity/suitability, clarify pre-arrival options, evaluate changes; commission assessment if structural suspected.
Correct public-info errors, standardize amenity-descriptions, tighten front-desk communication with checklist confirming arrival/service changes, monitor compliance.
Sweep climate control and finishes, update guest-facing information, commission assessment to determine scope and investment.
